title: heladena albiflora
intro: Heladena albiflora, commonly known as White Datura, is a plant species belonging to the nightshade family and native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and pain, due to its health benefits of sedation and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Heladena albiflora include its sedative and anticholinergic effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as epilepsy and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Heladena albiflora include scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
